title: S04T02 - Implement review request, claim, approve, and request-changes workflows
description: Provide atomic commands and agent workflows for entering review, claiming review ownership, recording findings, approving, and returning work for changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Review commands are JSON-first, reservation-safe, idempotent, and reject ambiguous subjects or stale commit scopes.
Requested changes reopen only the required work, preserve earlier rounds, and emit the next implementation or review command.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
